Agent Name: Mesopotamian_Number_Systems_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred during the calculation step when the expert misapplied the positional values and interpretation of the symbols. In the Babylonian numerical system, the notation schemes and base-60 system placement should have been properly interpreted from the symbols. A mistake was made by assigning values inconsistently, leading to an incorrect total calculation of 661 instead of 536. Specifically, while interpreting the symbols, the value was improperly calculated by not accurately accounting for the base-60 layout regarding how numbers beyond 59 are composed in their positional significance. This misinterpretation resulted in the wrong conversion of a series of symbols and thus produced an incorrect decimal conversion.
